title: The Rose of Sharon

questions.question: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:1 (ESV): "I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys."

questions.question: As a lily among brambles, so is my love among the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:2 (ESV): "so is my love among the young women."

questions.question: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:4 (ESV): "and his banner over me was love."

questions.question: My beloved is mine, and I am whose?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:16 (ESV): "My beloved is mine, and I am his;"

questions.question: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem... that you not stir up or awaken love until it does what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:7 (ESV): "that you not stir up or awaken love until it pleases."

questions.question: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am sick with what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:5 (ESV): "refresh me with apples, for I am sick with love."

questions.question: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping over the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:8 (ESV): "leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills."

questions.question: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:9 (ESV): "My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag."

questions.question: Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away, for behold, the winter is what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:11 (ESV): "for behold, the winter is past; the rain is over and gone."

questions.question: Catch the foxes for us, the little foxes that spoil the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:15 (ESV): "the little foxes that spoil the vineyards,"

questions.question: As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:3 (ESV): "so is my beloved among the young men."

questions.question: By the gazelles or the does of the field, I adjure whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:7 (ESV): "I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the does of the field,"

questions.question: The fig tree ripens its figs, and the vines are in blossom; they give forth what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:13 (ESV): "and the vines are in blossom; they give forth fragrance."

questions.question: O you who dwell in the gardens, with companions listening for your voice; let me what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 8:13 (Note: This is chapter 8, likely error in sourcing for chapter 2 quiz creation process, checking text for ch2). Re-checking Ch 2 text. Question: "O my dove, in the clefts of the rock... let me hear your voice." (2:14)

questions.question: O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the crannies of the cliff, let me see your what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 2:14 (ESV): "let me see your face, let me hear your voice,"

key_verse_text: My beloved is mine, and I am his; he grazes among the lilies.
